about:
Oklahoma Textile LLC was founded in 2009 in Moore, Oklahoma, a suburb of Oklahoma City. The family-run business was started by Trent Dodson and Mark, who still answer customer calls directly. The company began as a commercial laundry service focused on providing medical-standard sterility for healthcare facilities in the OKC metro area.

The company operates a commercial laundry service using an advanced Ozone Laundry System that sanitizes textiles with a powerful natural oxidizer. Every customer's laundry is washed separately to eliminate cross-contamination, with bespoke wash programs tailored to each facility. Services include healthcare textiles (patient gowns, lab coats, hospital linens), mops, rags, and towels (microfiber mops, shop rags, bath and bar towels), bar and gym towels, and janitorial products (urinal cakes, air fresheners, facility essentials) delivered on the same route. The company handles pickup and delivery on flexible schedules adapted to client volume and operating hours.

Oklahoma Textile serves hospitals and health systems, clinics and medical offices, restaurants and bars, and facility and janitorial teams across the Oklahoma City metro area. Their programs are built for each industry: healthcare textiles sanitized to medical-grade standards, bar and kitchen towels kept fresh for service, and custodial closets stocked via combined laundry and janitorial deliveries.

The company differentiates itself through three core pillars: medical-standard sterility achieved via ozone sanitation, flexible scheduling with no long-term contracts or auto-renewals, and direct customer service from the founders. They emphasize no lock-in contracts, no cancellation fees, and a free cost analysis upfront.

name: Okuhara Foods Inc
old_description: Home of Hawai'i's original fishcake, Okuhara Foods has been a local staple since 1946.
about:
Okuhara Foods Inc. operates from Honolulu, Hawaii, where it was founded in 1946 as a family-owned business. The company began as a modest operation producing fishcake, a traditional Japanese staple made from pureed white fish that is seasoned, shaped, and steamed until firm.

Today, the manufacturer produces a range of seafood-based products including its signature fishcake (kamaboko), customer-favorite Misoyaki Butterfish, and pre-marinated salmon fillets. The production process centers on fish pureeing, seasoning, forming, and steaming, along with marination and ready-to-cook meal preparation. Products are packaged for retail distribution.

Okuhara Foods supplies grocery retailers across Hawaii, with its products stocked at chains such as Times, Don Quijote, Marukai, and Big Save. The company serves the local consumer market and the broader foodservice sector seeking authentic Japanese-style seafood items.

The company emphasizes its heritage as Hawaii’s original fishcake maker, blending tradition with innovation to maintain a presence in the community for over 75 years.

name: Oliver Machinery
old_description: Oliver Machinery can trace its roots all the way back to 1890 in Grand Rapids, Michigan. The company, founded by Joseph W. Oliver, originally designed and manufactured wood trimmers that reduced labor time from 15 minutes to only a few seconds, winning Oliver a gold medal for merit at the 1900 World's Fair in Paris. In 1908 Oliver introduced the round cutterhead, a much safer alternative to the standard square cutterhead. The new safety feature was so apparent that many states soon began requiring their installation. Our founder also filed one of the first patents for a dado blade, this style is still being used today.
about:
Oliver Machinery traces its origins to 1890 in Grand Rapids, Michigan, where founder Joseph W. Oliver began designing and manufacturing wood trimmers that dramatically reduced labor time. The company later relocated to Renton, Washington, where it remains headquartered today.

The firm produces a full line of woodworking machinery, including tablesaws, jointers, planers, shapers, round rod milling machines, edge sanders, spindle sanders, and drill presses. It also manufactures its own HCX helical cutterheads and inserts, a product line developed over more than 20 years of cutterhead engineering.

Oliver serves high-end hobbyists and small commercial woodworking operations through its Heritage Collection of smaller-capacity tools, while its broader equipment lineup targets professional woodworking shops and industrial users.

The company’s early innovations — such as the 1908 round cutterhead that replaced hazardous square cutterheads and an early dado blade patent still in use — established a reputation for safety and durability that continues to inform its current helical cutterhead designs.

about:
Omega Car & Truck Accessories, operating as Omega Customs, was founded in 2011 in Alma, Arkansas. The company serves the River Valley region of Northwest Arkansas from two locations in Alma and Fort Smith.

The shop specializes in aftermarket automotive accessories and installation services. Its offerings include computer-cut window tinting with a lifetime warranty, wheel and tire packages from major brands, lift kit installations, and a range of exterior upgrades such as grille guards, bed covers, truck toppers, and side steps. Interior upgrades cover floor mats, leather interiors, stereo and infotainment systems, LED lighting, and seat covers. The company also provides ADAS calibration services for modern vehicle safety systems. Omega Customs holds master-level MECP (Mobile Electronics Certified Professional) and ASE (Automotive Service Excellence) certifications, and is the exclusive dealer for A.R.E. and Leer truck toppers in the River Valley.

Customers include individual vehicle owners, commercial fleets, emergency service vehicles, and work trucks across Northwest Arkansas and the River Valley. The business supports fleet upfitting for commercial and emergency applications, offering accessories that enhance functionality and safety.

Omega Customs differentiates itself with a price-match guarantee, lifetime warranty on window tinting, certified technician installations, and online visualization tools—an Interactive Garage and Wheels Visualizer—that let customers preview modifications before purchase. Flexible financing is available through Affirm.

name: Omega Leads
old_description: Cable assembly and custom wire harness manufacturer, 55+ years
about:
Omega Leads, founded in 1971, is a privately owned and operated cable assembly and wire harness manufacturer based in Santa Monica, California. The company began as a supplier to OEMs and manufacturers across multiple industries and has remained a domestic producer for over five decades.

The company produces custom cable assemblies, wire harnesses, and related wire processing services using computer-controlled robotic equipment. Capabilities include wire cutting, stripping, crimping, termination, identification, labeling, and electrical testing. Omega Leads offers turnkey solutions with in-house application engineering, prototyping, and first-article inspection, building products to IPC/WHMA-A-620 standards under an ISO-compliant quality system.

Omega Leads serves medical, aerospace, automotive, military, electronic, lighting, and solar industries. Its customers include OEMs and manufacturers requiring custom interconnect solutions for demanding applications such as medical devices, aerospace wire harnesses, automotive wiring, and military equipment.

The company emphasizes domestic manufacturing, consistent communication, and the use of high-quality materials from major connector suppliers such as Molex, TE Connectivity, and Deutsch. Its differentiators include decades of experience, competitive pricing, and a full-service approach from design through production.

name: Omnia Medical
old_description: Omnia Medical’s innovative implants set a new standard in surgical practice and patient outcomes. Our results speak for themselves. Patients and physicians agree – Omnia works for all.
about:
Omnia Medical is an orthopedic implant company based in Morgantown, West Virginia. Co-founded by Chris Henneforth, who serves as chief financial officer, the company was established by a group of top engineers and industry professionals with a goal of creating safe, effective, and revolutionary medical devices.

The company designs and commercializes a portfolio of spinal implants and biologics, including the PsiF DNA sacroiliac joint stabilization system, PsiF90 and PsiFGuard instrumentation, posterior SI fusion devices, cervical and standalone ALIF interbody devices (TiBrid C and TiBrid SA), a rotatable interbody system (Rotary), demineralized bone matrix (DBLogix), allogenic bone scaffold (CeLLogix), and a vertebral body replacement (Boxcar). The products are developed through surgeon collaboration and cleared via FDA 510(k) pathways.

Omnia Medical serves spine surgeons, neurosurgeons, and interventional pain specialists, supplying hospitals and surgical centers with implants for degenerative sacroiliitis, joint disruptions, and other spinal conditions. Its solutions are used in posterior SI joint stabilization, cervical and lumbar fusion procedures, and vertebral body replacement.

The company emphasizes reducing operative time through reproducible instrumentation, achieving superior surgical outcomes, and delivering cost savings for hospital partners and patients. Its founding principles center on innovation, surgeon collaboration, and optimizing patient outcomes.

name: On The Spot Assembly
old_description: Quality workmanship and competitive pricing. Serving Central Texas near the Silicon Hills of Austin, TX.
about:
On The Spot Assembly operates from Granger, Texas, in the Central Texas corridor near Austin's Silicon Hills. The company was founded in 2011 by Ernest G., who launched the business after more than 15 years in the electronics industry, including roles at multiple startups focused on RF and analog applications where he handled IC layout and full circuit-board assembly.

The shop specializes in quick-turnaround micro-electronic assembly for prototype and mid-volume runs with no minimum order quantity. Its privately owned facility houses a precision placement machine (PPM) for SMT placement, magnification workstations for hand assembly, custom fine-pitch solder stations, a framed stainless-steel stencil system accepting sheets up to 23 by 23 inches, and an ultrasonic cleaner using 99.9% isopropyl alcohol or de-ionized water. Processes cover surface-mount and through-hole placement, single- and double-sided boards, fine-pitch components down to 0201 and 0.35 mm QFN/DFN packages, BGA, TQFP, PLCC, and QFN assembly, as well as prototype rework including trace repair, component stacking, and fine-wire modifications.

Customers include engineering teams at startups and established firms developing RF, analog, and mixed-signal hardware in the Central Texas region. The company supports the full prototype iteration cycle, offering phased batch deliveries, on-site rework assistance, and courier service for local clients.

The founder established OTSA to simplify and accelerate the PCB assembly process, reducing product development time for innovators. The operation emphasizes honest communication, diligent workmanship, and a well-defined IPC Class 2–based process that can be customized per project, with a guarantee to resolve any issues that arise.

name: OnChip Devices
old_description: OnChip Devices, Inc head-quartered in Santa Clara, CA is a global leader in Integrated Passive Devices. With an advanced silicon fabrication facility and strong partnerships with full turn-key assembly houses in Asia, OnChip is offering state-of-the-art silicon and ceramic solutions for High-brightness LED, Computing and Consumer Electronics.
about:
OnChip Devices, Inc. is headquartered in Santa Clara, California. The company operates an advanced silicon fabrication facility and maintains partnerships with full turn-key assembly houses in Asia.

The company manufactures Integrated Passive Devices (IPDs) that combine resistors, capacitors, and diodes on a monolithic silicon substrate, as well as Thin Film and CMOS components. Its capabilities include wafer services, testing services, and 100% visual inspection of wafers or bare die performed to MIL-STD-883 Method 2010 using low- and high-power microscopes. Inspection covers defects such as embedded foreign material, metallization voids, contamination, surface scratches, and dicing defects. Services are offered at wafer level or after dicing in waffle packs or gelpaks.

OnChip serves the high-brightness LED, computing, and consumer electronics markets. Its devices are used in handsets, notebook PCs, MP3 players, and printers. The inspection services meet commercial, military, and medical electronics specifications.

The company states that its integrated approach enables design engineers to reduce component size for miniaturization, optimize performance through superior high-frequency and low-noise characteristics, lower total system cost by reducing part count, improve design cycle time, and improve reliability.
